rule.title: Clothing and household items must be in good used condition or better

when_missing.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this clothing or a household item that is not in good used condition or better (and not a single item over $500 with a qualified appraisal and Form 8283)?

citation.wording: However, this rule doesn't apply to a contribution of any single item for which a deduction of more than $500 is claimed and for which you include a qualified appraisal and Form 8283 with your tax return.
